Maria (Platform): quick midnight handoff. short version: we had a KV-cache eviction cascade in us-west-2 affecting Dedicated pools between ~22:40 and 23:15 UTC. impact limited to a narrow customer set but caused p95 blips and a handful of 503s. mitigation applied, monitoring in watch window. no data corruption.

Maria (Platform): Current coverage: Devon primary, Tilly secondary. Jason is OOO today; no extra infra standby until 03:00 UTC. Kevin covering customer comms.

Devon (oncall): Pager came in at 22:41 — spike in kv.evictions/sec and a bump in gateway 5xx for /v1/chat. Quick triage: eviction policy on autoscaler misfired under a short decode burst, selected many small-shard candidates.

Devon (oncall): Actions I took:
- 22:43: switched routing policy to "dedicated-degraded" for the most affected host subset
- 22:47: set autoscaler.eviction_window=30s and autoscaler.max_evict=2 to slow the loop
- 22:52: performed rolling restart of three nodes (graceful drain) in host-az-2
- 23:06: restored normal routing, errors trended back down

Devon (oncall): Commands (copied):
```bash
redwoodctl routing set-policy dedicated-degraded --exclude-tags host-az-2
redwoodctl config set autoscaler/eviction_window 30s
redwoodctl config set autoscaler/max_evict 2
redwoodctl nodes drain host-az-2-4 host-az-2-5 host-az-2-6 --grace 60s
```

incidents-bot: INCIDENT #1499 | severity: medium -> mitigated
- created: 2183501241
- signal: kv_eviction_cascade
- status: mitigated, monitoring
- runbook applied: rb/kv-eviction-basic

Tilly (sre): Verified that after the restarts the eviction rate dropped to baseline. Checked heap/disk/pod restarts: nothing abnormal except the eviction counts. I added an annotation on dashboard at 23:08.

Tilly (sre): Suggested next steps: add smoothing to autoscaler (10s min-sample) and reduce sensitivity to ephemeral decode spikes. Also recommend a synthetic that mimics short decode bursts.

Kevin (support): Handled two inbound support chats (Acct: NovaMetrics, LatticeFlow). Both experienced transient failures; I offered timeline and will send the follow-up note. NovaMetrics wants a postmortem.

Maria (Platform): Customer impact summary for handoff: about 9% of requests for 2 Dedicated customers experienced 5xx over ~35 minutes; p95 peaked ~2.4s. Retry logic covered most user-facing errors but we should proactively notify those customers.

Devon (oncall): Follow-ups I will own:
- Create ticket ENG-ops-1501: autoscaler smoothing + unit tests (assign to infra team)
- Correlate decode throughput traces with eviction triggers (attach logs)

Tilly (sre): My overnight checklist while monitoring:
- watch alert: `eviction_rate > 4 for 3m`
- ensure `autoscaler.eviction_window >= 30s` remains set
- confirm at least 2 warm spare nodes in us-west-2

Devon (oncall): Small log snippet from the peak period:
```
[22:45:18] autoscaler: observed short_burst throughput spike (decode 120r/s)
[22:45:18] autoscaler: candidate eviction list length=9
[22:45:19] kv: evict shard-199 -> freed 9kb
[22:45:20] gateway: 503 served for /v1/chat (kv miss)
```

Maria (Platform): Escalation thresholds for tonight: page secondary if eviction_rate > 6/s for >5m or p95 > 2s for >10m. If metrics degrade quickly, open a bridge and tag `@oncall-all`.

Kevin (support): I'll prepare and send the customer note to affected accounts within 1 hour. Draft will be in #support-digest; will CC account owners.

Tilly (sre): Coverage note: I'm here for config rollbacks if needed. If I need to intervene, I'll annotate here and perform a targeted restart of autoscaler replicas. Ping `@Tilly :rotating_light:` for urgent wakeups.

Devon (oncall): Links and artifacts:
- Incident: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1499
- Runbook used: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction-basic
- Dashboards: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/kv-evictions

Maria (Platform): Assigned actions:
- DEVON: open ENG-ops-1501 (autoscaler smoothing), attach logs and timeline (due EOD)
- TILLY: add synthetic test for short decode bursts, prepare rollback steps (ASAP)
- KEVIN: send customer outreach (within 1h)
- MARIA: add timeline and mitigation commands to incident record and schedule a postmortem if ENG-ops-1501 finds regression

Devon (oncall): Handoff complete. I'll re-check in 45m; if nothing new, Tilly will be primary for escalation after 02:30 UTC. Good night and ping here for any pages. :thumbsup:
